writtenTo: The 'elect lady and her children' (a church or a Christian woman)
importantNotes: 2 John is one of the shortest books in the Bible — only 13 verses.
The 'elect lady' may be a specific woman or a personification of a church.
Truth and love must go together — truth without love is harsh; love without truth is dangerous.
John warns against hospitality toward false teachers — don't fund heresy.
The letter shows the balance between Christian love and theological discernment.

chapters.1: Walk in truth and love; beware of deceivers who deny Christ came in the flesh.
